cards.heading: Dear you,
body: I wanted to write down a few things I don't say often enough.
There's no big occasion for this — just a Wednesday, and you, on my mind.

cards.heading: The little things
body: It's the small moments that stay with me: the way you laugh at your own jokes before you finish telling them, the playlists you make for no reason, the way you always save me the last bite.
None of it is dramatic. All of it is everything.

cards.heading: Lately
body: I've been noticing how much steadier things feel with you around. Not quieter — just steadier, like the ground makes a little more sense.
I don't take that for granted.

cards.heading: So, then
body: This is just a long way of saying thank you for being exactly who you are, and for letting me be exactly who I am around you.
cards.question: Will you keep doing life with me?
